title: Wendell and the Hollow
author: Isandro Galloway
blurb: Paloma Sterling, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
